entries.subject: Placement
entries.finding: Gaia DR3 source 4710594412266148352: position at J2016.0. Distance: Gaia DR3 parallax 7.1121 +/- 0.0236 mas (same row, RUWE 1.07): 140.61 pc, no zero-point correction. Proper motion: Gaia DR3 (same row): 79.128, -26.985 mas/yr. Radial velocity from the same row.

entries.subject: Radius, mass and temperature
entries.finding: Radius 0.4783 +/- 0.006 solar radii from Bakos et al. 2020, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of HATS-71 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2020AJ....159..267B/abstract). Mass 0.4861 +/- 0.006 solar masses from Bakos et al. 2020, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of HATS-71 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2020AJ....159..267B/abstract). Temperature 3405 +/- 10 K from Bakos et al. 2020, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of HATS-71 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive.

entries.subject: Color
entries.finding: A Planck spectrum at 3,405 K, because no archive holds a spectrum of this star (stis-ngsl: no HD number in SIMBAD; gaia-xp: Gaia DR3 published no sampled BP/RP spectrum of it; pulkovo: no HR number; kiehling: no HR number; kharitonov: no HR number; burnashev: no HR (BS) number), through the CIE 1931 2-degree observer: #ffc486. Routes tried in order: stis-ngsl: no HD number in SIMBAD; gaia-xp: Gaia DR3 published no sampled BP/RP spectrum of it; pulkovo: no HR number; kiehling: no HR number; kharitonov: no HR number; burnashev: no HR (BS) number; planck: used.

entries.subject: Limb darkening
entries.finding: The disc is dimmed toward the limb by the quadratic law Claret (2017), A&A 600, A30 computes from PHOENIX model atmospheres for the TESS band at 3,405 K and log g 4.77 (u1 0.168, u2 0.441): a model, because no fit of this star's limb is used.
